name: Mua Cave viewpoint
kicker: A stair over the rice and the karst
summary: A stone stair over rice and karst, 150,000 đồng a person. The view looks across the Tam Coc side of the valley, and the Ngo Đồng boat is a Tam Coc ticket. Hotline 0987 111 312. The support line is 02293.619.679. Climb while the paddies are still in the light. The stair is the visit.
getThere: From the valley, or a ride from Ga Ninh Bình.
heroCaption: Rice, karst, and the stone steps at Hang Múa

notice.title: The view looks over Tam Coc
notice.body: The Ngo Đồng boat is a Tam Coc ticket. This ticket is the stair, at 150,000 đồng a person.

body: The walk is a stone stair to a viewpoint. The wide frame is daylight on the paddies, with the steps in the corner so you know you climbed. The second frame is the valley from the same height: river, rice, and towers, with the stair out of the corner.
The ticket is 150,000 đồng per person. A child under 1 m is free, or pays the same 150,000 đồng. The hotline is 0987 111 312. The support line is 02293.619.679.

figures.caption: The valley from Hang Múa, river and karst without the stair
figures.alt: A green valley, a river, and limestone ridges seen from Hang Múa

gettingThere: The stair sits on the Tam Coc side of the valley. Ride from the valley or from Ga Ninh Bình. The ticket line names the site and the hotline.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: Ride or walk to the stair. The view from the top looks back over the rice and the river.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: A ride from Ga Ninh Bình, kilometre 115 from Hà Nội. SE7 arrives at 08:16.

admissionNote: 150,000 đồng per person. A child under 1 m: free, or the same 150,000 đồng. Hotline 0987 111 312. Support phone 02293.619.679.
